responsibility: Implements type checking for top-level Rust HIR items and the deeper validation phase for impl blocks. It resolves modules, functions, ADTs, aliases, statics, traits, extern blocks, and impls into TyTy types; computes impl self types and generic substitutions; checks where-clauses and function bodies; validates trait impl completeness and member compatibility; and records associated trait-impl mappings needed by later path and associated-type resolution.
same_name_distinction: Contains the concrete top-level item type-checking pass and impl-block validation logic, including enum variant resolution, function-body checking, impl self/substitution computation, and trait-impl completeness checks. The paired rust-hir-type-check-item.h only declares the TypeCheckItem visitor and helper entry points.
